data.title: Farm Gardens
data.about:
Farm Gardens is a chic development in Dubai with a country feel. It is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to live year-round in a place well-suited to farming getaways and to develop a new family home in an affluent neighborhood surrounded by peaceful countryside.

Emaar provides farmhouse villas with 4 to 5 bedrooms in The Valley, a calm and exclusive community. You may leave an enduring legacy with your family and friends for years in a pristine setting perfect for fitness, sports, enjoyment — and the pursuit of happiness.

location_tile.title: Farm Gardens’ placement in Dubai’s The Valley underscores its strategic importance.
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
The setting, which is serene and far from the bustling metropolis, provides a peaceful haven. It is located on Al Ain Road, which links Dubai and Sharjah. The Valley’s extensive road network infrastructure ensures simple and convenient access to Dubai’s many cities.

25 Mins from Burj Khalifa
20 Mins from Downtown Dubai
25 Mins from Dubai International Airport
08 Mins from Dubai Outlet Mall
25 Mins from the Dubai Mall
